artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan making the TODO.md 'Grouped by Topic' summary lines markdown-safe, title-aware, and word-boundary truncated at both slice sites in generate-task-order.sh, with a new regression suite and an .opencode render-side parity port.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo, a shell test for a core script that sources deploy-root-guard.sh cannot execute the source-store copy in place -- the guard aborts anything not under */.claude or */.opencode. The working harness (established by test-errors-append.sh) is to mktemp -d a scratch project root, create <scratch>/.claude/scripts/, and copy in the tool plus deploy-root-guard.sh and lib/common.sh, so the guard's case matches and PROJECT_ROOT resolves to the scratch. Orthogonally, tool resolution order decides WHICH copy is under test: deploy-tree-first (the common convention) silently tests the stale deployed script and only goes green after a deploy, so a suite written alongside a source-store fix must resolve source-store-first -- the deliberate inversion documented in test-postflight-deploy-gate.sh. Unchanged dependencies keep the deploy-first order.
